segments.an5.68:1.1: “Pubbevāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno pañca dhamme bhāvesiṃ, pañca dhamme bahulīkāsiṃ [bahulimakāsiṃ (ka.), bahulamakāsiṃ (ka.)].
segments.an5.68:1.8: So kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ ussoḷhipañcamānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā yassa yassa abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ abhiññāsacchikiriyāya,
segments.an5.68:1.9: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
segments.an5.68:2.1: “So sace ākaṅkhiṃ – ‘anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhaveyyaṃ … pe … yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteyyan’ti,
segments.an5.68:2.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane.
segments.an5.68:3.1: “So sace ākaṅkhiṃ … pe …‘āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan’ti,
segments.an5.68:3.2: tatra tatreva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇiṃ sati sati āyatane”ti.

lines: Aṭṭhame attano bodhimaṇḍe paṭividdhe āgamanaiddhipāde kathetvā upari attanova cha abhiññā kathesīti.
66-70. Chaṭṭhe saha ājīvanti etthāti sājīvo, pañhassa pucchanaṃ vissajjanañca.
